description: Golden scenarios for the measures-based tariff calculator (issue #1785). Each expected duty is taken from the chapter content files (industryAreas matrix cells, tariffUpdates.inEffect, worked examples) — the verified truth. Run: pnpm tariff:calc-scenarios. Quantities use HTS unit codes (KG, NO, L).

scenarios.description: Purebred breeding horse (male) from Germany, $50,000
scenarios.sourceNote: Chapter 01 Rates by country: Germany x 0101 = 10% (EU: 10% in place of the base rate, 9903.05.39; tariffUpdates.inEffect eu-301, effective 2026-07-24, USTR Section 301 FR notice).

scenarios.description: Purebred breeding horse (male) from Canada, $50,000, no USMCA claim
scenarios.sourceNote: Chapter 01 Rates by country: Canada x 0101 without USMCA = 10% (Free base + 10% Section 301, 9903.05.29; inEffect ca-301, effective 2026-07-24).

scenarios.description: Same horse from Canada with a USMCA claim (SPI S) on a Free-base line
scenarios.sourceNote: Chapter 01 Rates by country: Canada x 0101 with USMCA = Free (base already Free; Section 301 does not apply to USMCA-qualifying goods, 9903.05.93). The line has no special-rate column, but the USMCA claim still matters for the 301 exemption.

scenarios.description: Purebred breeding horse (male) from Mexico, $50,000, no USMCA claim
scenarios.sourceNote: Chapter 01 Rates by country: Mexico x 0101 without USMCA = 10% (Free base + 10% Section 301, 9903.05.55; inEffect mx-301, effective 2026-07-24).

scenarios.description: 60 steers for immediate slaughter from Canada, 21,000 kg, $100,000, no USMCA claim
scenarios.sourceNote: Chapter 01 Rates by country: Canada x 0102 without USMCA = 1¢/kg + 10% (base 1¢/kg x 21,000 kg = $210 + 10% Section 301, 9903.05.29; inEffect ca-301, effective 2026-07-24).

scenarios.description: Same 60 steers from Canada with a USMCA claim (SPI S)
scenarios.sourceNote: Chapter 01 Rates by country: Canada x 0102 with USMCA = Free (Free under USMCA (S); Section 301 does not apply, 9903.05.93).

scenarios.description: 500 goats from New Zealand, $100,000 (no trade-deal claim)
scenarios.sourceNote: Chapter 01 worked example '500 goats from New Zealand': 68¢/head x 500 = $340 base + 12.5% Section 301 (9903.05.57) = $12,500; inEffect other-301 lists New Zealand at +12.5% (effective 2026-07-24). New Zealand is not a matrix row (falls under 'Any other country', Free–12.5%).

scenarios.description: 500 goats from Australia, $100,000, Australia FTA claim (SPI AU)
scenarios.sourceNote: Chapter 01 tariffUpdates.inEffect other-301 whatItMeans: '500 goats from Australia: the 68¢/head base rate is Free under the Australia FTA, but the 12.5% Section 301 duty still applies' (Australia +12.5%). 0104.20 special column lists AU.

scenarios.description: 60 steers from China, 21,000 kg, $100,000
scenarios.sourceNote: Chapter 01 Rates by country: China x 0102 = 1¢/kg + 20% (12.5% Section 301, 9903.05.31 + 7.5% List 4A, 9903.88.15).

scenarios.description: Purebred breeding horse (male) from China, $50,000 (Free base)
scenarios.sourceNote: Chapter 01 Rates by country: China x 0101 = 20% (Free base + 12.5% 9903.05.31 + 7.5% 9903.88.15).

scenarios.description: 60 steers from Germany, 21,000 kg, $100,000 (EU 10% replaces the 1¢/kg base)
scenarios.sourceNote: Chapter 01 Rates by country: Germany x 0102 = 10% (10% in place of base, 9903.05.39).

scenarios.description: 60 steers from Mauritius, 21,000 kg, $100,000, AGOA claim (SPI D)
scenarios.sourceNote: Chapter 01 Rates by country: Mauritius x 0102 = Free (Free under AGOA (D), through 2026-12-31; Mauritius is outside the 60 Section 301 economies).

scenarios.description: 60 steers from Mauritius, 21,000 kg, $100,000, no AGOA claim
scenarios.sourceNote: Interpreted from the Chapter 01 Mauritius rule ('Base rate only' — no Section 301, reciprocal duty ended 2026-02-24): without the AGOA claim only the 1¢/kg base applies, 21,000 kg x $0.01 = $210. The matrix cell assumes the AGOA claim.

scenarios.description: Asses (0101.30, 6.8% base) from Canada with a USMCA claim, $10,000
scenarios.sourceNote: Chapter 01 Rates by country: Canada x 0101 with USMCA = Free (9903.05.93).

scenarios.description: Laparotomy sponges (gauze) from Brazil, $100,000
scenarios.sourceNote: Chapter 30 Rates by country: Brazil x 3005 = 37.5% (+12.5% 9903.05.27 + 25% Brazil Section 301, 9903.05.01; inEffect br-301 effective 2026-07-22, s301-fl effective 2026-07-24).

scenarios.description: Ostomy appliances from Brazil, $100,000 (4.2% base)
Patented antineoplastic medicament (Section 232 list) from Switzerland, $100,000
scenarios.sourceNote: Chapter 30 Rates by country: Switzerland x 3004 (232 list) = 15% patented (in place of base, 9903.04.62; inEffect s232-deal15 effective 2026-09-29).

scenarios.description: Patented antineoplastic medicament (Section 232 list) from India, $100,000
scenarios.sourceNote: Chapter 30 Rates by country: India x 3004 (232 list) = 100% patented (in place of base, 9903.04.60; inEffect s232-default effective 2026-09-29). Section 301 does not cover 3004.

scenarios.description: Generic antineoplastic medicament from India, $100,000
scenarios.sourceNote: Chapter 30 Rates by country: India x 3004 (232 list) = Free generic (9903.04.67).

scenarios.description: Patented antineoplastic medicament from the United Kingdom, $100,000
scenarios.sourceNote: Chapter 30 Rates by country: United Kingdom x 3004 (232 list) = Free (patented +0%, 9903.04.63; inEffect s232-uk effective 2026-07-31).

scenarios.description: Patented biologic (3002.13, Section 232 list) from Germany, $100,000
scenarios.sourceNote: Chapter 30 Rates by country: Germany x 3002 (232 list) = 15% patented (9903.04.62).

scenarios.description: Ostomy appliances from Singapore with an FTA claim (SPI SG), $100,000
scenarios.sourceNote: Chapter 30 Rates by country: Singapore x 3006 (3006.91) = 12.5% (4.2% base Free under the U.S.–Singapore FTA (SG); +12.5% Section 301, 9903.05.68, still applies).

scenarios.description: Ostomy appliances from Germany, $100,000 (EU 10% replaces the 4.2% base)
scenarios.sourceNote: Chapter 30 Rates by country: Germany x 3006 (3006.91) = 10% (10% in place of base, 9903.05.39).

scenarios.description: Liquid placebo kits (0.2¢/liter) from China, 1,000 liters, $10,000

line.special: Free  (A, AU, BH, CL, CO, D, E, IL, JO, KR, MA, OM, P,PA, PE, S, SG)

scenarios.sourceNote: Chapter 30 Rates by country: China x 3006 (3006.93.60) = 0.2¢/liter + 25% (List 1/2/3 Section 301, 9903.88.03): $2 + $2,500.

scenarios.description: Placebo kits with other chemicals (3006.93.80, 5% base) from Japan with a U.S.–Japan claim (SPI JP), $100,000

line.special: Free  (A+, AU, BH, CL, CO, D, E, IL, JO, JP, K, KR, MA,OM, P, PA, PE, S, SG)

scenarios.sourceNote: Chapter 30 Rates by country: Japan x 3006 (3006.93.80) = Free (U.S.–Japan Trade Agreement (JP): Free; no Section 301 coverage).

scenarios.description: Acetaminophen (2924.29.62.10, 6.5% base) from India, pharmaceutical use NOT confirmed, $100,000
scenarios.sourceNote: U.S. note 52(e) lists 2924.29.62 but exempts it only when for use in pharmaceutical applications (9903.05.89). Unconfirmed, so the India 2026 Section 301 duty applies: 6.5% base ($6,500) + 10% (9903.05.44, $10,000) = $16,500.

scenarios.description: Acetaminophen (2924.29.62.10, 6.5% base) from India for use in pharmaceutical applications, $100,000
scenarios.sourceNote: U.S. note 52(e) / heading 9903.05.89: 2924.29.62 is on the list and the pharmaceutical end use is confirmed, so 9903.05.44 (India, +10%) does not apply. 6.5% base only = $6,500.

scenarios.description: Acetaminophen (2924.29.62.10, 6.5% base) from Brazil, pharmaceutical use NOT confirmed, $100,000
Acetaminophen (2924.29.62.10, 6.5% base) from Brazil for use in pharmaceutical applications, $100,000
scenarios.sourceNote: 2924.29.62 is on both U.S. note 52(e) (9903.05.89 removes 9903.05.27) and note 50(a)(v) (9903.05.06 removes 9903.05.01); the pharmaceutical end use is confirmed, so only the 6.5% base is due = $6,500.

scenarios.description: Men's cotton T-shirts (6109.10.00.12, 16.5% base) from Guatemala, no CAFTA-DR claim, $10,000
scenarios.sourceNote: Without a CAFTA-DR claim: 16.5% base ($1,650) + Guatemala 2026 Section 301 10% (9903.05.40, $1,000) = $2,650. The U.S. note 52(j)(6)(iii) exception (9903.06.06) needs entry claimed under CAFTA-DR.

scenarios.description: Men's cotton T-shirts (6109.10.00.12) from Guatemala, CAFTA-DR claimed (SPI P), $10,000
scenarios.sourceNote: CAFTA-DR special rate (P) for 6109.10.00 = Free; 6109.10.00 is on the U.S. note 52(j)(6)(iii) list, so heading 9903.06.06 removes 9903.05.40 for goods entered under CAFTA-DR (general note 29). Total $0.

scenarios.description: Men's cotton T-shirts (6109.10.00.12) from El Salvador, CAFTA-DR claimed (SPI P), $10,000
scenarios.sourceNote: CAFTA-DR special rate (P) = Free; 6109.10.00 is on the U.S. note 52(j)(7)(iii) list, so heading 9903.06.09 removes the El Salvador 10% duty (9903.05.37). Total $0.

scenarios.description: Patented anticonvulsant API (2933.99.65.00, 6.5% base) from India, no company program, $100,000
scenarios.sourceNote: U.S. note 40(c) lists 2933.99.6500. Patented, no company program: 9903.04.60, total 100% when the column 1 rate is below 100% (note 40(d)) = $100,000. 9903.04.60 is in 9903.04.60–.66, so the India 301 duty does not stack (note 52(f)(8)).

scenarios.description: Patented API (2933.99.65.00, 6.5% base) from India, manufacturer has a Commerce-approved onshoring plan, $100,000
scenarios.sourceNote: Heading 9903.04.64 (note 40(h)(i)): "The duty provided in the applicable subheading + 20%" instead of 9903.04.60; 301 excluded by note 52(f)(8). 6.5% ($6,500) + 20% ($20,000) = $26,500.

scenarios.description: Patented API (2933.99.65.00, 6.5% base) from Germany, manufacturer has an onshoring plan, $100,000
scenarios.sourceNote: For EU goods the 15% rate of 9903.04.62 (total 15% when column 1 is below 15%, note 40(f)) is lower than the 20% onshoring rate, and Proclamation 11020 clause (8) applies the lowest rate, so the onshoring claim changes nothing: $15,000.

scenarios.description: Patented API (2933.99.65.00, 6.5% base) from India, manufacturer has onshoring + MFN pricing agreements, $100,000
scenarios.sourceNote: Heading 9903.04.65 (note 40(h)(ii); Proclamation 11020 clause 3(e)): base rate + 0% instead of 9903.04.60; 301 excluded by note 52(f)(8). 6.5% base only = $6,500.

scenarios.description: Patented API (2933.99.65.00) from India entered 2026-08-15, manufacturer listed in Annex III, $100,000
scenarios.sourceNote: Proclamation 11020 clause (4) / CSMS # 69395344: Annex III companies paid the Section 232 duty from July 31, 2026 under 9903.04.60 (total 100%) = $100,000.

scenarios.description: Patented API (2933.99.65.00, 6.5% base) from India entered 2026-08-15, manufacturer not in Annex III, $100,000
scenarios.sourceNote: CSMS # 69395344: until September 28, 2026 other companies enter under 9903.04.61 (0%); 9903.04.61 is in 9903.04.60–.66 so the India 301 duty does not apply (note 52(f)(8)). 6.5% base only = $6,500.

scenarios.description: Patented drug ingredient (2933.99.65.00, 6.5% base) from India with a U.S.-origin active ingredient, $100,000
scenarios.sourceNote: Heading 9903.04.68 (Proclamation 11020 clause 11; CSMS # 70054007): 0% Section 232. 9903.04.68 is outside 9903.04.60–.66, so the India 2026 Section 301 duty (9903.05.44, +10%) still applies: $6,500 + $10,000 = $16,500.

scenarios.description: Patented API (2933.99.65.00, 6.5% base) from India solely for clinical trials / R&D, $100,000
scenarios.sourceNote: Heading 9903.04.70 (91 FR 60360; CSMS # 70054007): 0% Section 232 for research use. Outside 9903.04.60–.66, so the India 301 duty (+10%) still applies (the 52(e) pharmaceutical-use exemption is not claimed): $6,500 + $10,000 = $16,500.

scenarios.description: Safflower seeds for sowing from India, $10,000, named product confirmed (note 52(c))
scenarios.sourceNote: U.S. note 52(c), relief 9903.05.87: 'Safflower (Carthamus tintorius) seeds, for sowing' exempt from 9903.05.20–.84; base Free.

scenarios.description: Same line from India, description not confirmed
scenarios.sourceNote: No confirmation: Free base + 10% Section 301 (9903.05.44, India).

scenarios.description: Psyllium seed husks from Malaysia, $20,000, Malaysia named product confirmed (note 52(j)(4)(ii))
scenarios.sourceNote: U.S. note 52(j)(4)(ii), relief 9903.06.01 lifts 9903.05.54 (Malaysia 10%); without it $2,000.

scenarios.description: Acai (2008.99.21) from Brazil, $10,000, only the note 50(a)(iii) description confirmed
